I have added more debug outputs. 
The `getcwd` function ([src](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/bionic/+blame/refs/heads/main/libc/bionic/getcwd.cpp)) fails on your device, but we can determine the error codes.

```cpp
	getcwd(real_current_dir_name, 2048);
	print_line("getcwd errno: ", errno, ", real_current_dir_name: ", real_current_dir_name);
```

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Errno.h#POSIX_errors

On my device, I usually see `errno = 2`, ("No such file or directory.") 
No problem, the cache folders are created in the project path `/storage/emulated/0/Documents/.....` afterward.
_(or this is the last error from another failed function, I think)_
